notes.title: Street Crime Mission – June 2025 Update
notes.content: [h3]Controls & Input[/h3][list][*][p]Click anywhere in-game to lock (hide) the cursor; press [b]Esc[/b] to unlock (show) it.[/p][/*][*][p]Sprint only while [b]holding[/b] Shift—no more toggle.[/p][/*][*][p]Accept mission calls with [b]Enter[/b] or [b]Space[/b] in addition to the on-screen prompt.[/p][/*][/list][h3]UI & HUD[/h3][list][*][p]Player-arrow icon in the mini-map reduced by ~50 %.[/p][/*][*][p]Big mini-map auto-hides when a mission call appears.[/p][/*][*][p]Health bar added behind the player car; AI cars now have health bars too (fade green → black as they take damage).[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy-score panel realigned with the game screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Removed old AI-car role icons (Thief, Drunk, Stolen); all AI-car mini-map icons are now red.[/p][/*][*][p]Mini-map arrow sizes (big & small) reset correctly after calls.[/p][/*][*][p]Default game icon updated.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Vehicles[/h3][list][*][p]Stronger brakes for every player car.[/p][/*][*][p]Brake lights now work even on Low graphics settings.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Alpha Patrol[/b]: mass increased, handling tweaked, faster pickup.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bravo Sentinel[/b] and [b]Cobalt Enforcer[/b]: handling balanced.[/p][/*][*][p]All shop car prices re-tuned for current balance.[/p][/*][*][p]Player car auto-resets if it gets stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Gear-shift sound volume lowered to 0.5.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Combat & Enemies[/h3][list][*][p]Assault-rifle bullet damage reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]Shotgun hand pose corrected when firing.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy overlap bug fixed—no more stacking when 5–6 foes rush you.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemy “sliding” in some FPS missions fixed; they now walk/run normally.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Mission-Specific Tweaks[/h3][list][*][p][b]All FPS missions[/b][/p][list][*][p]+1 minute added to the timer.[/p][/*][*][p]Player car now spawns outside each rescue-target building.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Stay Away From AI Car[/b][/p][list][*][p]13 extra AI cars added.[/p][/*][*][p]Safe-zone position moved.[/p][/*][*][p]AI-car paths realigned with the road.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Chasing[/b] missions: AI target car despawns instantly after you press [b]Continue[/b] on success.[/p][/*][*][p][b]President Escort[/b]: three additional escort vehicles placed along the route.[/p][/*][/list][h3]NPC & Animation Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Airport-exterior NPC now sits in a fear pose until rescued, then stands normally.[/p][/*][*][p]Rescued NPCs stand normally instead of freezing in rescue pose after mission completion.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Difficulty & Balance[/h3][list][*][p]Enemy count increased—roughly 15–25 hostiles per mission.[/p][/*][*][p]AI-car health values adjusted to match the new health-bar system.[/p][/*][*][p][b]“Two Hits”[/b] achievement condition updated to reflect balance changes.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Quality of Life[/h3][list][*][p]Removed “Press E to grab object” text when interacting with health packs.[/p][/*][*][p]Player starting car positions refined in every mission to avoid awkward spawns.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]If you spot anything that still feels off, let us know on the community hub—your feedback keeps the game improving![/p]

notes.title: Street Crime Mission – Update Highlights
notes.content:
[b]Street Crime Mission – Patch Notes[/b]

[b]AI Improvements[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed the AI aggressiveness bar so enemy behavior now scales correctly
[*]Resolved issue where the enemy car icon in the HUD was hiding vehicles—icons now display clearly without obstruction
[/list]

[b]Code & Performance Optimizations[/b]
[list]
[*]Refactored mission scripting for smoother frame rates
[*]Reduced load times when spawning multiple AI units
[*]General bug fixes and memory optimizations under the hood
[/list]

[b]New Sound Tracks[/b]
[list]
[*]Added three high-energy background tracks tailored for chase sequences
[*]Updated in-mission ambient sounds for more atmospheric tension
[/list]

Thanks for playing and sharing your feedback! Keep patrolling the streets, and watch for further enhancements soon.
